Gears of War: E-Day's upcoming weekend beta suddenly gets PvP due to fan demand

The Gears of War E-Day open beta is kicking off soon, and just as players were ready to hop into a good few days of Horde, The Coalition has announced that PvP versus will also be present in the test, albeit for a limited time.

author: Eurogamer
text:
"We take your feedback to heart" - Game Freak promises to improve Beast of Reincarnation following a divisive launch

Beast of Reincarnation is out but hasn't quite made the splash you might expect from Game Freak's first original project in years. The long-time Pokémon developer isn't moving on, however, and is promising to deliver a series of updates to improve the game.

Assassin's Creed Valhalla director makes sudden return to Ubisoft, and will lead the series moving forward

The director of Assassin's Creed Valhalla, Black Flag, and Origins has returned to Ubisoft to lead development on future Assassin's Creed games.

author: Eurogamer
text:
Diablo 4 players have long wanted to bring their Eternal characters into the Seasonal realm, and now they're getting their wish, sort of

Blizzard is introducing a long asked-for feature in Diablo 4 in the game's next update, which is already on the Public Test Realm for testing. The feature is called Rebirth and it finally allows you to use characters from the Eternal realm for Seasonal content.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
Marvel Rivals' next update drastically reduces the game's install size on PC and console

In a world afflicted with ever-increasing storage and RAM costs, it's nice to see a game make a serious effort to reduce its footprint on your SSD. Cue Marvel Rivals. On PS5 and Xbox, you will see an install-size reduction of roughly 15GB - down from 73GB - whilst the PC version reduces by a whopping 40GB. This means we're getting a reduction of roughly 20 percent on consoles, whereas on PC the file size will shrink by over 57 percent.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
A PC cooling company shows Sony and Nintendo how it's done, as it pledges to pass US tariff refunds onto customers

Arctic, a well-known manufacturer of PC air and water coolers, has made a commitment to use the tariff refunds it received from the US government to lower the price of its products. This is notable because it's in stark contrast to the approach Nintendo has opted for, believing it has no obligation to pass these refunds onto consumers.

Resident Evil Veronica remake already proving popular for Capcom, as wishlists reach an impressive milestone

Capcom announced that Resident Evil Veronica - a remake of Code: Veronica - has achieved an impressive milestone well before it's even out. The game has topped 2 million wishlists across PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox and Switch 2.
